title: Implement newton_solve() with config, BC enforcement, history, exports
objective: Implement the Newton-Raphson driver in solver/newton.py: NewtonConfig/NewtonResult dataclasses, newton_solve() function with Dirichlet enforcement, history commit/rollback, convergence diagnostics, and load_stepping compatibility. Update solver exports.

plan_assets.asset_description: NewtonConfig, NewtonResult dataclasses and newton_solve signature

implementation_steps: Read ref_hex8_elastic.py:solve_elastic (lines 364-466) as the reference pattern
Read ref_hex8_plastic.py as the pattern for history integration
Read load_stepping.py callback signature: newton_solve_fn(load_factor) -> (converged, n_iters, residual_history)
Implement NewtonConfig dataclass with tol, max_iter, cg_tol, cg_max_iter fields
Implement NewtonResult dataclass with converged, n_iterations, residual_history fields
Implement newton_solve() following the ref_hex8_elastic pattern: residual assembly → BC zero → convergence check → CG solve → BC zero increment → update
Add Dirichlet enforcement: R[bc_mask]=0, du[bc_mask]=0, Kv[bc_mask]=v[bc_mask] (identity row)
Add optional history: history.commit() on convergence, history.rollback() on failure
Add convergence diagnostics via Python logging module
Default linear solver to CGSolver() if none provided
Ensure NewtonResult fields are compatible with adaptive_load_stepping callback contract
Update solver/__init__.py to export newton_solve, NewtonConfig, NewtonResult
acceptance_criteria: Callback-based: accepts assemble_residual and tangent_matvec callables
Dirichlet enforcement: constrained DOFs zeroed in residual and increment
Matvec wrapper applies identity row for constrained DOFs
History commit/rollback when history parameter provided
Returns NewtonResult with converged, n_iterations, residual_history
NewtonResult compatible with load_stepping callback contract
verification_commands: uv run python -c "from mechdsl.solver import newton_solve, NewtonConfig, NewtonResult; print('OK')"
risks: newton.py callbacks don't match reference solver patterns. Mitigation: Design callbacks to exactly match the patterns in ref_hex8_elastic.py::solve_elastic (assemble_residual=lambda u: f_ext - assemble_internal_force(u, ...), tangent_matvec=lambda u,v: apply_tangent_matvec(u, v, ...)). Write integration test (P3-T3) that uses the reference solver's assembly functions as callbacks.
